What We Do

Retention marketing,
end to end.

Every service we offer connects back to one goal — increasing how much each customer is worth to your business.

01 / RETENTION

E-commerce Retention Setup

We build the full retention stack for your store — flows, campaigns, segmentation and automations — so your existing customers spend more and churn less.

  • Post-purchase & loyalty flows
  • Win-back & lapsed customer sequences
  • VIP & high-LTV segmentation
  • Repeat purchase optimisation
02 / SUBSCRIPTIONS

Subscription Management

We handle the full subscription lifecycle — from onboarding new subscribers to reducing churn, recovering failed payments and reactivating cancelled members.

  • Subscription welcome & onboarding flows
  • Failed payment recovery sequences
  • Churn prevention & cancel-save flows
  • Subscriber reactivation campaigns
03 / ACQUISITION

List Growth & Lead Capture

Turn your site traffic into a retention asset. We build the capture mechanisms, sign-up flows and lead magnets that grow a list worth marketing to.

  • On-site pop-ups & embedded forms
  • Lead magnet strategy & delivery
  • Welcome series optimisation
  • SMS & email dual opt-in setup
04 / PLATFORM

Klaviyo & Platform Setup

Full Klaviyo configuration, integration with your e-commerce platform, deliverability hardening and ongoing technical management so everything runs cleanly.

  • Klaviyo account setup & migration
  • Shopify / WooCommerce integration
  • Deliverability & DNS authentication
  • List hygiene & suppression management

Strengths

Why work with us

01

Retention First, Always

Acquiring a customer costs 5x more than keeping one. We focus on making sure every customer you win stays, spends more, and comes back.

02

Full-Funnel Visibility

From first purchase to sixth order — we track every touchpoint. You always know where customers drop off and exactly what’s being done about it.

03

Revenue Per Customer

We optimise for lifetime value, not one-time conversions. Every flow, campaign and segment is built to increase what each customer is worth.

04

Built Around Your Brand

Your voice, your offers, your customers. Every message feels like it came from you — built around your brand, not copied from a freelancer’s template library.

05

Platform-Agnostic Setup

Klaviyo, Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce — we work across every major e-commerce stack and configure the retention infrastructure that fits yours.

06

Numbers, Not Noise

Monthly plain-language reports showing repeat purchase rate, LTV uplift, flow revenue and churn reduction. Metrics that actually move your business.

FAQ

Got questions?

Here are the answers you’re looking for.

What services do you offer?
+
We offer full-spectrum retention marketing: strategy, flow automation, campaign copywriting, Klaviyo setup & management, deliverability audits, and list growth systems.
How can retention marketing benefit my business?
+
Email delivers $36 for every $1 spent — the highest ROI of any marketing channel. It keeps customers coming back, recovers abandoned cart revenue, and builds a direct relationship that no algorithm can take away.
Do you handle email automation?
+
Yes — automation is our core strength. Welcome series, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, win-back, VIP — all set up in Klaviyo to run 24/7.
Can you help improve my email open rates?
+
Absolutely. We audit subject lines, sender reputation, list health, send timing, and segmentation. Typical improvement: 8–15% lift in open rates within 30 days.
Do you work with all email platforms?
+
We specialise in Klaviyo for e-commerce, but also work with Mailchimp, Omnisend, ActiveCampaign and Postscript. We handle full migrations too.
How do you measure campaign success?
+
Open rate, click rate, conversion rate, revenue attributed, and unsubscribe rate. Monthly plain-language report every time — no spin, no inflated numbers.
